name: ShapeGrid-TS-TW
title: Shape Grid
description: A canvas of thin violet squares covers the stage and slides on a diagonal. Moving the pointer fills the hovered cell and leaves a short trailing line of lit cells behind it.
use: A dark tech or product section wants a moving grid that answers the pointer.
avoid: Hundreds of thin lines can look busy behind small copy and cost frames on weak phones.
a11y: A canvas backdrop with no labels; the scroll and hover trail ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black stage is covered edge to edge with a grid of thin violet squares, evenly spaced. A few cells fill solid violet, and a dark vignette fades the corners away.
behaves: The grid drifts on a diagonal and wraps round without a seam. Wherever the pointer goes, the cell under it lights up and a short trail of filled cells fades out behind.
customise: Direction, speed, cell size, border and hover colours, shape and trail length are props; the vignette colour is hardcoded.
weight: moderate: Redraws roughly 300 stroked cells on a 2D canvas every frame.
